content: The dashboard is extremely slow when loading analytics. Takes 30+ seconds. This is frustrating for our team.
Just deployed my first Worker and it was SO easy! The docs are really clear. Love this platform!
Workers AI model selection is confusing. Which model should I use for sentiment analysis? Documentation doesn't explain use cases.
Your billing is broken. Been trying to upgrade for 2 days. Support hasn't responded.
D1 database query performance is excellent! Much faster than our previous solution.
Error messages when deploying are cryptic. What does 'binding not found' actually mean?
The Workers dashboard UI is cluttered. Hard to find where to add bindings. Spent 20 mins searching.
R2 storage is a game changer for our app. Saved us so much on AWS costs!
Documentation for D1 migrations is missing. How do I handle schema changes in production?
Workers cold start time increased after recent deploy. Seeing 500ms+ latency now.
Cloudflare Pages + Workers is the perfect combo. Deployed my full-stack app in 10 minutes!
KV storage limits are too restrictive for our use case. Need more flexibility on value sizes.
